text: My daily routine is fairly consistent, which helps me stay organized. I usually wake up at six-thirty, and my morning habits are simple: a glass of water, a quick shower, and a light breakfast of toast and coffee. By eight o'clock, I'm at my desk, since my work schedule runs from nine to five. I focus on my main tasks before lunch, when I’m most productive. In the late afternoon, I make time for exercise, either a thirty-minute run or a yoga session. After dinner, my evening activities involve reading or watching a show to unwind. I am usually in bed by eleven, ready to do it all again.
